## Basic Concepts: Vectors [00:00:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0uimNNIuUyY&t=20s)

**Vectors** represent ordered lists of numbers in m-dimensional space.

- A vector **p** of length 500 can represent closing prices of all S&P 500 stocks
- **Portfolio value** = **q** · **p** (dot product of quantities and prices)
